# K3-on-Prime Harness

K3-on-Prime is a control-and-evidence Harness built on the Prime Agent execution runtime.

Prime Agent remains the engine: CLI/TUI, daemon and workers, `AgentSession`, persistent IPython, RLM subagents, skills, compaction, goals, schedules, and session recovery. K3 adds explicit capability boundaries, append-oriented evidence, stage gates, canaries, empirical selection, effort controls, and domain-specific verification.

This is a forked research and engineering repository. It is **not** an unmodified Prime Agent checkout, and it is not an official Prime Intellect release.

## Status

The current snapshot must be read on four separate axes:

| Axis | Current status |
| --- | --- |
| K3 implementation files | Substantially implemented |

| Unified target-architecture wiring | Partial |
| Focused test files | Present; run results must be reported per change |
| Full real-entrypoint acceptance | Not proven by source presence alone |

Important open target-state work includes a single fail-closed K3 assembly root before `AgentSession`, complete takeover of the real kernel-spawn boundary, and changing active Harness refinement from direct apply to externally verified candidate promotion. Do not infer that those paths are complete merely because supporting modules exist.

    K --> G["Stage gates and canaries"]
